name: Developer
description: Build and run workloads in the Dev account, Sydney region only.
leastPrivilegeRationale: Assigned in Dev only, so it grants nothing in Prod. Allows a fixed list of build services and only in ap-southeast-2. Cannot create IAM users, access keys or roles (blocks the usual privilege-escalation paths), can only pass roles under the /dev-app/ path, and cannot stop or alter CloudTrail.
